_comment: One-way source ownership ceilings. Deletion and line-neutral ownership moves pass; new packages, binaries, 1000-line module paths, a larger maximum module, or aggregate owned Rust growth require an explicit reviewed update.
_todo_2026_08_03: TODO(v0.9.5): aggregate ceiling bumped 649350 -> 659633 during v0.9.4 train hygiene, then 659633 -> 662389 at the end of the train (incl. the 2026-08-04 downtime bug-hunt fixes) (corrected tool descriptions, the File parameter hardening split, and the work-bar persistence/click regression fix). The 30-PR stack on 2026-08-02/03 grew owned production Rust by ~10.3k lines; both new thousand-line modules from the stack (crates/tui/src/native_memory.rs, crates/tui/src/tui/views/fleet_roster.rs) were split back under the threshold instead of raising the per-file ceilings. v0.9.4 overspent; pay the aggregate back down by deletion/dedup in v0.9.5 rather than treating this as the new normal. Reviewed 2026-08-05 for the v0.9.4 Fleet rebuild: aggregate 662389 -> 668406 and three new 1000-line modules (fleet/store.rs 1114 - the named Fleet store v2; tui/transcript.rs 1062 - the release-quality transcript pass; views/fleet_detail.rs 1056 - the secondary named-Fleet editor behind /fleet fleets). Split candidates for v0.9.5.

No new 1000-line modules; growth is in existing files. Pay down in v0.9.5.
_todo_2026_08_05_ui_split: v0.9.4 ui.rs decomposition (the first ceiling DECREASE in this file's history): crates/tui/src/tui/ui.rs 19132 -> 3657 lines, moved verbatim into eleven ui/ submodules (event_loop, apply, handlers, dispatch, frame, session_state, provider_routes, overlays, terminal, release_check, motion). max_module_lines 19110 -> 17596 - the largest production module is now crates/tui/src/main.rs, not ui.rs. large-module count 168 -> 174 and aggregate +417 lines are the arithmetic cost of the split itself (per-module headers and `use super::*`), not new behavior; no logic changed and `cargo test -p codewhale-tui --bins` stayed at 9851 passed / 0 failed across the move. Remaining floor: run_event_loop is a single 4565-line function, so ui/event_loop.rs cannot shrink further by moving code - it needs genuine decomposition (v0.9.5). Same for handle_view_events (1152), apply_env_overrides_unlocked (1073), apply_command_result (960).
_todo_2026_08_06_windows_lane: v0.9.4 Windows/no-sandbox test-lane repair: aggregate 673296 -> 673375 (+79 lines). The 12 failures blocking the ship were not Windows-only - 7 fail on any host with no OS sandbox backend (all Windows, Linux without bubblewrap), and release.yml's parity job runs the full suite on ubuntu-latest, so the tag itself would have failed. Growth is a pinned sandbox backend in the underwater test fixture plus one new test covering the unenforced rendering the fixture no longer exercises, the rooted-mention and native-separator fixes in file_mention, and their comments. No new modules; growth is in existing files. Pay down in v0.9.5.
_todo_2026_08_06_unreleased: Post-0.9.4 [Unreleased] work: aggregate 673375 -> 676325 and max module 17596 -> 17631. The bulk is Agent Plugins v1.0.0 consume/publish/slugify (a new plugins/agent_plugin.rs plus manifest/registry/export wiring, ~2.3k lines with its tests). The rest is the sub-agent billing work — the agent_spawned stream event that makes a child's model visible, the RLM block-intent scanner, memory revise/retire with journals, and the harness audit trail. main.rs takes the module bump from the stream event. No new packages or binaries. The standing note still applies: this is a ledger, not a new normal — pay it down by deletion and dedup rather than treating growth as routine.

_todo_2026_08_08_scout_evidence: v0.9.5 Scout evidence profile: aggregate 684000 -> 684975 (+975 production Rust lines after the hidden continuation-cap deletion). The growth centralizes one normal/headless catalog and dispatch contract for an eight-tool evidence profile, a direct-argv read-only shell with executable/path/environment/Git/GitHub guards, parent authority intersection, and a typed Verifier-only bounded Run capability. No new package, binary, or thousand-line module; large-module count remains 179. The same reconciliation locks in the existing largest-module improvement 17700 -> 17680 and removes main.rs from the thousand-line allowlist. This is an explicit release-boundary re-baseline, not an assertion that the added security boundary is free; pursue deletion/dedup after v0.9.5.
_todo_2026_08_08_release_review: Final v0.9.5 review reconciliation: aggregate 684975 -> 685165 (+190 net Rust lines). This is the net result after deleting duplicate routes and unreachable fields/helpers while adding the single-history persistence boundary, complete locale registry coverage, provider-aware auto-routing cleanup, OAuth/MCP/goal regressions, safe relative-link resolution for fetched HTML, Scout catalog/depth corrections, and compact-terminal indicator budgeting. No new package, binary, or thousand-line module; the large-module count remains 179 and the largest module remains 17680 lines. Keep the post-release deletion/dedup obligation rather than treating this release-boundary growth as free capacity.
